semantics.BURN: Material/effect plus underlying ordinary pose; not independent source action state.
semantics.CARRY: Dive-tackled opponent, not carrying a crate.
semantics.ROCKET_RIDE: Existing base mechanic; not powered skill.
semantics.RUN_LEFT_RIGHT: Intended leg-phase labels in initial prompt; generated samples are not validated alternating contacts. Blaire instead differs in facing.
semantics.GRABBED: Paired tackle concept; actual live victim uses FALL_B. Not proof of standing grab combo.
semantics.START_AIM: Related phases and aliases; concept samples do not cover every transition.

known_concept_limits: Run A/B or left/right labels do not certify gait cycles.
Some WALK PASSING samples still resemble contact.
Some FRONT views retain slight three-quarter angle.
Hideki cover aim has ambiguous muzzle clearance.
Blaire hook resembles straight punch; axe-ready grip needs animator cleanup.
Agent blink visibility limited by sunglasses.
